crossRefs.note: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not…
For he will be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and will not fear when heat…
I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

translations.web: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.
translations.bsb: My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.
translations.kjv: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
translations.asv: My root is spread out to the waters, And the dew lieth all night upon my branch;
